messages.subject: Project Onyx - strategy before v3 goes back
messages.plaintextBody:
Team,

Before we send v3: I'm content to give 50 per cent Investor Majority and the £150k litigation threshold. Hold firm on the cap at £20m - a genuine win for the founders and Calderbrook indicated flexibility. On the limitation period, accept 18 months only if they drop the MFN in the IRA; otherwise 21. Let's not trade the non-compete below 12 months.

Elena - please make sure the cap table and funds flow are final and tie before completion.

Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
